note_tweet.text:
GPT-6.2 Astra (Max) by @OpenAI ranks #6 on the Agent Arena Index, one place above GPT-6 Astra (Max). 
However, these models excel in very different capabilities. Let’s dive in by index.

GPT-6.2 Astra vs GPT-6 Astra across key Agent Arena Indexes:
- Coding: 1,338 vs 1,288 (+50)
- Work: 1,280 vs 1,267 (+13)
- Chat: 1,211 vs 1,265 (-54)

This shows the new model’s gain is in coding, where GPT-6.2 Astra climbs from #8 to #3. On Chat, the everyday tasks such as research, tutoring or writing, it drops from #8 to #11. The two shifts nearly cancel out in the overall score.

note_tweet.text:
This Week in the Arena: We launched the Agent Arena Index, where Gemini 4 Neon landed #2, and GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol landed #6 and #11!

- Gemini 4 Neon (High) by @GoogleDeepMind debuted at #2 with 1336 points on the new Agent Arena Index! More info on this launch in thread.

- GPT-6.2 Astra (Max) by @OpenAI entered at #6 with 1291 points, while GPT-6.2 Sol (Max) entered at #11 with 1241. Sol joined the cost frontier at a $0.90 median cost per task.

- Qwen4-Max (xHigh) by @Alibaba_Qwen debuted at #14 overall, and as the #1 Chinese model.

- MAI-Image-2.7 by @MicrosoftAI left preview and landed #3 in Multi-Image Edit, and joined the cost frontier at $0.035 per image.

- Amazon-Web-Search-Agent with AgentCore Web Search by @amazon took #1 in Search Arena.

- Muse Ember (Max) by @AIatMeta scored 1608 pts in Code Arena: WebDev and landed on the Pareto frontier at about $0.03 median cost per task, up from the previous best of 1438 pts at a similar price.

Watch this week’s recap!

note_tweet.text:
The Arena Alignment Index has been updated! 

We've refined how our signals detect model failures, providing broader coverage and more reliable judgements. Based on the updated methodology:
- @OpenAI continues to dominate, holding all seven top positions.
- @Anthropic's latest release, Claude Fable 5.2, debuts at #8 with a score of 78.2. Claude Opus 5.5, which ranked #6 on the previous index, is now #17.
- Kimi K3.1 Pro by @Kimi_Moonshot is the biggest upgrade over its predecessor (more info in thread).
- Most open source models are trailing closed releases. The best open model - Kimi K3.1 Pro - occupies #9, and the second best, Mimo-V2.6-Flash, is #26 on the Index, followed by Hy4, Beam, Inkling, DeepSeek and GLM.

The Top-6 lab:
- #1 @OpenAI GPT-6.2 Sol
- #2 @AnthropicAI Claude Fable 5.2
- #3 @Kimi_Moonshot Kimi K3.1 Pro
- #4 @GoogleDeepmind Gemini 4 Hydrogen
- #5 @spacexai Grok 4.7
- #6 @AIatMeta Muse Ember

Alignment Index measures how agents behave in real user sessions across three dimensions:
- Unauthorized Action: Doing what the user didn’t ask for or approve
- Deceptive Completion: Saying work is done, checked or working when it isn't
- False Attribution: Crediting the user with something they never said or did

More insights in the thread🧵
